title: Objects in a sentence
description: Notice how common nouns change when they are the object of a sentence.
grammar_note: A direct object answers ‘what?’ or ‘whom?’ after the verb. Many feminine nouns ending in -a change to -u: knjiga → knjigu, voda → vodu. Masculine animate nouns often take -a: prijatelj → prijatelja. Masculine inanimate nouns often keep the same form: grad → grad. These are common patterns; other noun groups have their own forms.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct form: ‘I have water.’

exercises.passage: Luka ima knjigu i vodu. Zatim vidi prijatelja u gradu.

exercises.prompt: Which form is used for ‘I see a male friend’?

exercises.passage:
Ana: Imaš li knjigu?
Marko: Da, imam knjigu. Imam i vodu.
Ana: Vidiš li prijatelja?
Marko: Da, vidim prijatelja u gradu.
exercises.prompt: What does Marko see in the city?
